chunks: Jaʿfar ibn ʿAbdullāh, head of al-Miḍrī, Abū ʿAbdillāh. I saw a book of his, al-Mutʿa, that Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad ibn Saʿīd ibn ʿAbd al-Raḥmān al-Hamdānī narrates from him. And a group has reported to us from him.

key_terms.الْمُتْعَةِ: The book of al-Mutʿa (likely referring to temporary marriage or a specific treatise)
key_terms.رَأْسُ الْمِذْرَى: Head of the Miḍrī (a tribal or geographical designation)

ai.seo_question: Who is Jaʿfar ibn ʿAbdullāh al-Miḍrī and what is his book al-Mutʿa?
ai.summary: This biographical note identifies Jaʿfar ibn ʿAbdullāh, known as the head of al-Miḍrī, and mentions a specific book of his titled 'al-Mutʿa' which is narrated by Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad al-Hamdānī. It also notes that a group of scholars has reported from him, establishing his status as a narrator.
